title: Shaded and Non-Shaded Parts
objective: Identify and represent shaded and non-shaded parts of one whole as fractions.

problems.text: Whisper the fraction of the shape that is shaded. Then, match the shape to the amount that is not shaded.

sub_problems.question: How many eighths are in 1 whole?
How many ninths are in 1 whole?
How many twelfths are in 1 whole?

problems.text: Each strip represents 1 whole. Write a fraction to label the shaded and unshaded parts.
Avanti read 1 sixth of her book. What fraction of the book has she not read yet?
